name: Yamanashi (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Yamanashi city emblem in green: a stylised swirl of overlapping curved strokes in three shades of green.
history: Municipal flag of Yamanashi, a city in Yamanashi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 22 March 2005.

features.role: Yamanashi city emblem — a stylised swirl of overlapping curved strokes in three shades of green
